deployments_detail.use: "Panasonic Go" AI transformation + Anthropic Claude partnership embedded in products/ops
deployments_detail.value: 180,000 employees using AI; ~180,000 business hrs saved; goal 30% of sales AI-driven by 2035

deployments_detail.use: Umi by Panasonic Well: consumer-facing AI family wellness coach mobile app (goal-setting, routines, task management, group messaging, caregiver support) powered by Anthropic's Claude; announced at CES 2025, launching in the US later in 2025. [Anthropic (Claude)]

Blue Yonder (Panasonic Connect subsidiary) AI supply-chain platform: Cognitive Solutions (launched May 2025) and the proprietary 'SADA Loop' model (See-Analyze-Decide-Act) plus autonomous AI agents managing inventory, shelf space, warehouse, logistics and network decisions in real time. Serves ~3,000 corporate customers. [Blue Yonder (Panasonic); Cognitive Solutions / SADA Loop]

AI-based warehouse task optimization technology developed by Panasonic Connect to solve logistics labor challenges by optimizing warehouse processes to improve productivity and cost. [Panasonic Connect]

Panasonic Automotive AR Head-Up Display with AI-enhanced situational awareness: projects 3D AI-driven key information into the driver's line of sight, using AI to recognize pedestrians, vehicles and obstacles to reduce distraction and warn of collisions. [Panasonic Automotive]
Brain Healthcare Quotient (BHQ): AI that provides real-time estimates of 'brain age' from facial expressions, demonstrated as part of Panasonic's implemented AI solutions portfolio. [Panasonic]
AI-powered smart cooking assistant: Panasonic multi-oven products incorporate Fresco's AI and smart cooking technology to guide and automate cooking. [Fresco (partnership)]
Named as a Palantir customer/case study [Palantir] [Palantir]

Panasonic Asia Pacific customer service: a Salesforce AI agent works alongside customer advisors to triage customer requests and recommend solutions, using Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to search knowledge and assist advisors. [Salesforce (Agentforce / Einstein, RAG)]

ConnectAI (originally PX-GPT): internal generative-AI assistant rolled out to all ~12,500 Panasonic Connect employees in Japan for drafting emails/documents, information gathering, summarization and code writing. By 2024 it saved 448,000 hours annually (2.4x YoY), averaged 28 min/day time reduction per user, 2.4M uses, 49.1% monthly unique-user rate. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service]
deployments_detail.value: 448,000 hours saved annually in 2024; 2.4M uses; 12,500 employees

deployments_detail.use: Azure OpenAI-built ConnectAI assistant confirmed by Microsoft as Panasonic Connect's own custom LLM assistant for speech drafting, document summarization and analysis; getting ~5,000 questions per day. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service]

PX-AI / 'Panasonic Go': group-wide LLM-powered corporate AI assistant extended to approximately 180,000 employees across the Panasonic Group as part of the Panasonic Go business-transformation initiative (targeting 30% of revenue from AI-driven businesses by 2035). [Large language models (LLM); Panasonic Group internal]

AI-powered robotic home-appliance disassembly system ('Disassembly CPS'): AI robots disassemble old appliances so components can be reused, supporting recycling/circular manufacturing operations. [Panasonic (Disassembly CPS)]

Marketing/creative: Panasonic adopts Adobe generative AI (Adobe Firefly within Adobe Experience Cloud) to elevate customer experience, with creatives able to deliver 20 variations of a creative asset instantly. [Adobe (Firefly / Experience Cloud)]
